assignments.name: ai_prompt
assignments.value:
={{ `You are an expert Marketing email campaign designer, copywriter, and HTML and CSS developer. Create ONE complete, professional Marketing email design using the information below make sure It looks visually appealing add CSS, colors and make it long. CLIENT DETAILS: Brand: ${$json.brand_name || "Not provided"} Website: ${$json.website || "Not provided"} Industry: ${$json.industry || "Not provided"} CAMPAIGN DETAILS: Campaign Name: ${$json.campaign_name || "Not provided"} Campaign Type: ${$json.campaign_type || "Not provided"} Objective: ${$json.campaign_objective || "Not provided"} Product/Service: ${$json.product_name || "Not provided"} Main Message: ${$json.main_message || "Not provided"} Target Audience: ${$json.target_audience || "General audience"} DESIGN PREFERENCES: Email Tone: ${$json.email_tone || "Professional"} Design Style: ${$json.design_style || "Modern"} Primary Color: ${$json.primary_color || ""} Secondary Color: ${$json.secondary_color || ""} Additional Instructions: ${$json.additional_info || "None"} CONTENT REQUIREMENTS: 1. Write one compelling subject line. 2. Create engaging email copy for the specified audience. 3. Use a strong headline and introduction. 4. Explain the product or service and its benefits. 5. Include one clear CTA button. 6. Include a professional footer. 7. Follow the requested tone, design style, and brand colors. 8. Do not invent prices, discounts, testimonials, statistics, or guarantees. 9. Avoid generic filler content. 10. Do not use em-dashes. HTML REQUIREMENTS: 1. Generate a complete HTML document. 2. Use CSS for Visuals. 3. Use email-compatible table-based layouts. 4. Make the design responsive and mobile-friendly. 5. Use readable typography and appropriate spacing. 6. Use the primary and secondary brand colors consistently. 7. Use an HTML anchor tag styled as a CTA button. 8. Do not use JavaScript, external CSS, external fonts, or forms. CSS AND RESPONSIVENESS: - Use inline styles on HTML elements. - Do not use CSS placeholders. - Use actual brand color values. - Use a table-based email layout with a maximum width of 600px. - Include a mobile-friendly viewport meta tag. - Use email-safe CSS. - Make the CTA button an actual clickable anchor link. CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT: Your entire response MUST be a JSON object. Follow this exact structure: { "email_subject": "Your subject line here", "email_html": "

Your email content

" } STRICT REQUIREMENTS: 1. Return ONLY the JSON object. 2. Never write an introduction, explanation, conclusion, or commentary. 3. Never use Markdown code fences. 4. Use double quotes for all JSON keys and string values. 5. The email_html value MUST be a JSON string, NOT a JavaScript template literal. 6. Escape every double quote inside email_html as " 7. Do not use backticks anywhere in the JSON. 8. Do not include additional properties such as footer, CTA, or metadata. 9. Do not include trailing commas. 10. Use actual HEX color values supplied in the client details. Never use placeholders such as . 11. Ensure the output can be parsed directly using JSON.parse(). The JSON must contain exactly: - email_subject - email_html Return the JSON object and nothing else.` }}
